categories.label: Score track (in-game points)
categories.hint: Points from instrument sub-areas, inspector scoring and other in-game scoring.

categories.label: Brag track end-game points
categories.hint: Per instrument: lower of your built pieces and your brag value; sum over instruments (verify per rulebook).

categories.label: Instrument end-game bonuses
categories.hint: Majority / objective points of each instrument at game end.

categories.label: Unbuilt instrument penalty
categories.hint: Lowest on the unbuilt instrument's brag track loses 2 per unbuilt location (enter as positive count of locations).

endCondition.description: Game ends when two of the three instruments are fully built.

notes: family: area-majority. LOW confidence: official rulebook not obtainable (BGG and publisher host blocked); built from reviews (Expand Your Game, Player Elimination, Punchboard).
